law: freeze BEFORE observing any Q10 result; no candidate/harness/environment edit after this point without dependency invalidation of the affected frozen measurements (BENCHMARKS.md); prior files kept

binding.source: per design 07, unchanged and preregistered: I00 integrates accepted deltas ONLY, builds A/B clean wheels and installs outside both checkouts (WS03 module/engagement proof); V00 runs the full bit/state/artifact/fault gauntlet on the installed candidate; Q00 freezes PRIMARY.json/configuration.json/freeze.json BEFORE any Q10 result; Q10 runs seven independent paired windows under AB/BA alternation, seed 20261003, 20000 bootstrap resamples over paired log ratios, decision = median and one-sided 95% lower bound >= 10; timer brackets ONLY the public RunBatch call; bitwise 64/64 vs the frozen P00 pin outside timing on EVERY measured window; cold stores both arms, per-tree warm numba caches, equal C=4 budget on the same host; no optional stopping; raw windows retained; R00 independent review; Z00 truthful close

invalidation_rule: a source, wheel, harness, environment or cohort change after this freeze invalidates affected measurements; the honest paths are re-freeze with a recorded invalidation or target_unmet - never a silent rerun
budget_note: Q10 measured public walls charge the heavy budget; V00/Q00 evidence walls are probe-scale
